# TodoMVC Fixture Project

This is a runnable React/Vite starter fixture for exercising the Hooky loop.

It is intentionally separate from the Hooky repository. Use it as a clean workspace seed when running TodoMVC loop experiments.

The fixture supplies a coherent project shell: `index.html`, `src/main.jsx`, `src/App.jsx`, CSS, package scripts, and Playwright config. It is not a completed TodoMVC implementation. The generator should turn it into a normal TodoMVC implementation after the evaluator accepts the contract.
